info.title: Sedis PartnerAPI v2
info.description:
The Sedis PartnerAPI v2 is a REST + JSON API for programmatic access to Sedis Fastighetsbenchmark and Bolagsanalys data.

Authenticate with the `X-Api-Key` header (issued per customer). Responses are camelCase and paged with the bare `{data, page, pageSize, totalCount, totalPages}` envelope.

A CompDatum value carries EXACTLY ONE of `figure` (decimal) or `date` (ISO `yyyy-MM-dd`): parameters whose code starts with 'D' are date-typed and populate `date` (with `figure` null); all others populate `figure` (with `date` null). The `lastUpdatedUtc` field is a full UTC instant.

The code-defined CompDatum enum domains are published as typed integer-enum component schemas (CompClassification = EA0, CompTransactionKind = EC0, CompTransactionType = ED0, CompEpcEnvironmentalRating = EE0, CompValuationMethod = EF0, CompValuationAgency = EG0, CompSustainabilityCertification = EH0); a CompDatum enum value's `enum.value` is the integer they enumerate. EB0 (PropertyType) is the exception: it is DATA-DRIVEN (a database table, not a compile-time enum) and therefore has no static schema — discover its live domain at runtime via `/v2/fastighetsbenchmark/property-types` (or `parameters/EB0` `enumValues`).

Writing (Fastighetsbenchmark): create property units with POST property-units and update them with PUT — an upload of values (POST comp-uploads) never creates a property unit. Writes are strict: a broken rule answers 422 `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with `errors[]` of `{ pointer, code, detail }` — pointer a JSON Pointer into the request body, code a stable machine-readable error code — and nothing is saved. Problem `type`s are stable URIs under `https://api.sedis.se/problems/`. POSTs need an `Idempotency-Key` header.

get.description: Returns the v2 comp-data list (camelCase, bare envelope), tenant-scoped via the parent Comp join. Each row is self-describing via dataType (decimal|boolean|enum|date — from the parameterCode's first letter): decimal populates figure; boolean populates boolean (+ raw figure); enum populates enum {value,name,enumType} (+ raw figure), its full domain discoverable via /parameters/{code}; date populates date (ISO yyyy-MM-dd). valueDate is the period the value applies to (the natural-key part), distinct from the date-typed value itself. post.summary: Stores a customer's values for one value date, optionally submitting them to Sedis.
post.description: One request = one value date, 1–1000 rows (body at most 5 MB). Each row names one of the calling customer's own property units by sedisId or exact name (case-insensitive) — given both, they must agree — and carries values keyed by base-data parameter code, typed by the parameter's dataType: decimal → number, boolean → true/false, enum → an integer from enumValues (EB0: an id from GET property-types), date → "yyyy-MM-dd"; null deletes the stored value, a code left out is left unchanged. A property unit may appear on one row only. valueDate must be the end of a quarter; until quarterly and half-yearly data is released, only 31 December. Strict: any broken rule → 422 (type …/problems/validation) with errors[] of { pointer, code, detail } and nothing is saved. Posting again for the same date replaces the upload while it is uploaded; once submitted or published → 409 (type …/problems/conflict, extensions.existingUploadId). submit: true sends it to Sedis for review in the same call and then also requires a property classification (EA0) and a property type (EB0) for every property unit on the value date. Requires an Idempotency-Key header. Returns 201 with Location and the upload, echoing each row's sedisId.

parameters.name: sort

parameters.name: fields

PartnerApiV2SearchRequest.description:
The request body for the per-resource `POST /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/{resource}/search` escape hatch
(D-36). Carries a complex geometry (GeoJSON geometry object OR a WKT string, SRID 4326) that would
exceed practical URL length on the GET equivalent, plus the SAME query-shape (page/pageSize/sort/fields/
count) and named filters the GET supports — so the response envelope, item schema, camelCase and tenant
isolation are identical. POST search sets `Cache-Control: no-store` and emits no ETag.

message.description: A culture-localized human-readable message (English default; Swedish via ?lang=sv).

PartnerApiV2StatusResponse.description: The camelCase status response (sealed record; serialized via the v2 base controller's V2Json).

id.description: The property-type id (the EB0 datum's figure, ← `PropertyType.PropertyTypeId`).

PropertyTypeRef.description: A resolved property-type reference — the `{id, name}` object derived from the EB0 datum.

PropertyTypeResponse.description:
A property type (Fastighetstyp) — item type for `GET /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/property-types`
(SED-1093). The domain of the `EB0` parameter: the id is the value an upload sends for EB0 and the
value `?propertyType=` filters on. Same rows as `parameters/EB0`'s `enumValues`.

streetNameAndNumber.description: Street name and number, e.g. "Sveavägen 12". At most 600 characters.

postalCode.description: Postal code, e.g. "111 57". At most 10 characters.

postalTown.description: Postal town (postort), e.g. "Stockholm". At most 100 characters.

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "SE" — the default when omitted in a request.

PropertyUnitAddress.description:
A property's postal address (SED-1093) — the same shape in requests and responses. The municipality and the
official designation are not part of it: they are the property's administrative identity, not its post.

name.description:
The property's name — the customer's internal designation (Intern beteckning). Required, unique per
customer (case-insensitive, surrounding whitespace ignored), at most 300 characters.

officialDesignation.description:
The official property designation (Fastighetsbeteckning), e.g. "Gladan 4". In Sweden it is unique only
together with the municipality, so int? PropertyUnitRequest.MunicipalityId is then required. It describes the
property and is never used to find a property unit — use `sedisId` or `name` for that.

oneOf.description:
The property's postal address — street, postal code, town and country belong together. Optional; the
country defaults to Sweden.

municipalityId.description:
The municipality id from `GET municipalities`. Must be in the address's country. Required for a
Swedish property that has an string? PropertyUnitRequest.OfficialDesignation.

oneOf.description:
The property's location as a GeoJSON Point (RFC 7946). `coordinates` is always `[x, y]`:
`[longitude, latitude]` for CRS84, `[easting, northing]` for SWEREF 99 TM — whatever the
formal axis order of the coordinate system. When given, it is the property's location and is never
overwritten by Sedis's own lookups; when omitted, Sedis locates the property from the official
designation or the address. Must lie in the municipality (Sweden) or the country.

geometryCrs.description:
The coordinate system of GeoJsonPointRequest? PropertyUnitRequest.Geometry: `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/OGC/1.3/CRS84`
(WGS 84 longitude/latitude — the default) or `http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/3006`
(SWEREF 99 TM). The short forms `CRS84`, `EPSG:4326` and `EPSG:3006` are accepted too.

PropertyUnitRequest.description:
The request body for `POST /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/property-units` (create) and
`PUT /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/property-units/{sedisId}` (full replace) — SED-1093. The only way to create
a property unit and the only way to rename one.

officialDesignation.description: The official property designation (← `PropertyUnit.OfficialDesignation`), when known.

oneOf.description:
The municipality as a resolved `{id, name}` object (← the `Municipality` nav), NOT the raw
`MunicipalityId` FK (D-31 / D-39). `null` when the property has no municipality.

address.description:
The property's postal address — street, postal code, town and country (SED-1093; the same shape a
`POST`/`PUT` takes). Properties registered before countries were recorded are Swedish.

postalAddress.description: Deprecated — use `address.postalTown`. The postal town, when known. Removed in a future v3.

postalCode.description: Deprecated — use `address.postalCode`. The postal code, when known. Removed in a future v3.

streetNameAndNumber.description:
Deprecated — use `address.streetNameAndNumber`. The street name and number, when known. Removed in a
future v3.

oneOf.description:
The property type as a resolved `{id, name}` object, derived from the property's
`EB0` (PropertyType) CompDatum value joined to the `PropertyType` lookup. `null`
when the property carries no EB0 datum. Filterable via `?propertyType=` (the type id).

sedisId.description:
The Sedis key (← `Comp.SedisId`): assigned by Sedis, never changes, case-sensitive — the id to store
and use in later calls. Filterable via `?sedisId=` (+ `in:`).

sourceName.description: The data source, exposed verbatim (← `Comp.SourceName`), e.g. "Nils Holgersson", "Sedis-AB".

insertedOnUtc.description: The ISO-8601 UTC instant the row was inserted (← `Comp.InsertedOnUtc`).

lastUpdatedUtc.description:
The data-freshness contract (D-37 ETag source): the latest of the row-level freshness timestamps,
`MAX(UpdatedOnUtc, RefreshedFromSourceOnUtc, FrozenOnUtc, InsertedOnUtc)`. Always populated (never a constant
`null` — see the type remarks).

isLocked.description: True when the row is locked (← `Comp.IsLocked`).

freezeOnSourceChanges.description: Phase-53 freeze state: true when the row is pinned and should not refresh from source.

sourceUpdateAvailable.description: True when the source has been recalculated since this row was last refreshed.

sourceUpdateAvailableSinceUtc.description: The ISO-8601 UTC instant a source update became available, when known.

refreshedFromSourceOnUtc.description: The ISO-8601 UTC instant the row was last refreshed from its source, when known.

frozenOnUtc.description: The ISO-8601 UTC instant the row was frozen, when frozen.

geometry.description:
GeoJSON geometry (SRID 4326), opt-in via `?fields=…,geometry` (D-25). Omitted by default
(payload weight + geography-materialization cost). Populated server-side in 62-07 AFTER the page
materializes (a settable member so the read service can attach the simplified Shape without an
immutable `with` against the abstract base).

belongsToJamforelseobjekt.description:
The tenant's Jämförelseobjekt (clone Zones) this Comp belongs to (the bidirectional clone-membership
lineage, 62-11), opt-in via `?fields=…,belongsToJamforelseobjekt`. The 2-hop REVERSE: the
caller's clones whose source SedisObjekt `ContainingComps` include this row — i.e.
`{ clone Zone : clone.IsCloneOfComp ∈ this.PartOfCompCollections }`. Omitted by default;
populated through the TENANT-FILTERED context (Risk E) so a caller only ever sees its own clones.
Settable so the read service can attach it post-materialization.

tags.description: The Comp's tags, opt-in via `?fields=…,tags`. Omitted by default; populated in 62-07.

PropertyUnitResponse.description:
A Fastighet — the v2 reshape of a PropertyUnit
(item type for `GET /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/property-units`). Extends
CompBaseResponse (OpenAPI `allOf`) with the property-unit-specific fields.

QuarterId.description:
Identifier for a calendar quarter, encoded as `yyyyq` (e.g. `20251`).
The encoded form is the persisted database value and the JSON representation.

containingCompSedisIds.description:
The SedisIds of the member Fastigheter (PropertyUnits) this Samling should aggregate AFTER the
update — a full replace of the member set. Only the calling tenant's own PropertyUnits are linked
(the update service filters by owner + source); SedisIds outside the tenant are silently ignored,
never written cross-tenant.

UpdateSamlingRequest.description:
The request body for `PUT /v2/fastighetsbenchmark/samlingar/{sedisId}` — a FULL REPLACE of an
existing customer-owned Samling's name and member set (SED-904). Same shape as
CreateSamlingRequest (a name plus the SedisIds of the member Fastigheter the collection
aggregates); kept as a distinct type so the create- and update-contracts can evolve independently and
the OpenAPI document names them separately.
